What if I told you that stores can trick your brain with just one cent?
But there's a reason so many prices end in 99.
Imagine you're shopping and see a shirt for $20.
Now imagine the same shirt costs $19.99.
But here's where your brain plays tricks on you.
When you see $19.99, you tend to focus on the first number.
And suddenly, the price can feel much cheaper than it actually is.
Businesses have used this strategy for decades because it can influence what customers buy.
Even when you know the trick, it can still work on you.
So next time you see something priced at $9.99...
Remember, that missing penny probably isn't there to save you money.
It's there to make you feel like you're spending less.
You didn't know that about money!
